# Msah Ambooka - Portfolio Context

Msah Ambooka is a Software Engineer and Full-Stack Developer based in Nairobi, Kenya. He combines a Computer Science foundation with practical experience in full-stack web applications, REST APIs, payment integrations, ERP implementation, IT infrastructure, and applied AI/ML.
